notes.title: Patch v1.13
notes.notes:
Hello Commanders,

Thank you for playing Taurus War,

We'll keep updating the game for 10 years，

This is the patch v1.13 that includes:

(1) Fixed the BUG where victory conditions were not displayed
(2) Fixed the BUG that the unit information is not displayed
(3) Increased the reward after winning
(4) Optimized combat values
(5) Optimized the novice value
(6) Optimized the battle scene

Good luck and have fun!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2755100
